verdict.rationale: The only AI capability in the evidence is the builder's AI Assistant, which generates copy and images. That is content generation, not AI-derived insights or suggestions from the user's data. Peak-engagement reporting and pre-send link and alt-text checks are standard analytics and rule-based validation, with no evidence that AI produces them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
